name: MEASUREMENT LOG
note: Measurement rows under the same conditions each time - the trend is the readout, not any single row.

name: BLOOD PANEL LOG
note: Blood panel results, one fasting draw per row - read the deltas against the previous row, not single values.

name: SYMPTOM LOG
note: Symptom rows: one event per row, with the suspected trigger written down while memory is fresh.

name: HAIR AND SCALP LOG
note: Hair and scalp entries: the monthly shed count, the photo it is read against, and what is actually in use.

name: MEDICATIONS AND SUPPLEMENTS
note: Medications and supplements with their doses - everything a prescriber or an assay would want to know about.

name: FAMILY HISTORY
note: Family history: first-degree relatives, ages at onset, and what that changes about screening.

name: APPOINTMENTS AND LABS
note: Appointment rows for every test, review and follow-up, with the date the result is due.
